# Setting Up OrderHub Desktop

**OrderHub Desktop (OHD)** is the program on your lab PC that downloads orders from OrderHub and sends them to your printers. Before it can do that, it needs to know which OrderHub account to connect to, where to download the artwork from, and where to save it on your PC.

This article covers installing OHD and the four Settings tabs you need to fill in first: **Connection**, **Downloads**, **General** and **Backup**.

---

## Before you start

You'll need these details. Keep them to hand:

| What | Where to get it |
|---|---|
| **API Key** | OrderHub → **Settings** → **API** tab |
| **Organization ID** | OrderHub → **Settings**, under your organisation's name |
| **Location ID** | OrderHub → **Settings** → **Locations** tab |
| **FTP Host, Username and Password** | Raise a support ticket in **myPixfizz** |

You need to be an OrderHub **admin** to see the **Settings** button.

---

## Step 1: Install OrderHub Desktop

1. In OrderHub, click **Settings** at the top of the Orders page.
2. Open the **Info** tab and scroll to the bottom.
3. In the **OrderHub Desktop** card, click **Download**.
4. Run the installer on the PC that will send jobs to your printers.
   * Note: new versions are posted in the same place, with a short note on what's changed.

![Downloading OHD](https://nazkcvruighrhpgcarxg.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/help-documentation-images/6c81169c-2045-4803-8bef-f9142972a3f9.png)

---

## Step 2: Get your details from OrderHub

### API Key

1. On the **Settings** page, open the **API** tab.
2. In the **API Integration** card, click **Generate Key**.
3. Leave **Integration Type** set to **Generic**.
4. Click the copy icon next to the new key.
   * Note: you can come back and copy the key again at any time with the eye and copy icons.
   * Note: use the key from the **API Integration** card, *not* the **Personal access tokens** card further down the same tab. Those are for a different tool and won't work with OHD.

![API Key](https://nazkcvruighrhpgcarxg.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/help-documentation-images/f1f15b0a-4b05-46f3-a9d0-fbc955d1bc51.png)

### Organization ID

1. On the same **Settings** page, look directly under your organisation's name at the top.
2. Click the copy icon next to the long ID ("Copy Organization ID").

![How to get Org ID](https://nazkcvruighrhpgcarxg.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/help-documentation-images/dba75ae4-859e-41c8-bc0f-191a4f75932f.png)

### Location ID

1. Open the **Locations** tab. This can be found by going to settings -> Pixfizz -> Select your Brand/Website
2. Find the location where this PC is, and click the copy icon next to its ID.
   * Note: if you have more than one location, each PC running OHD uses the Location ID of the shop it's in. OHD only downloads jobs for that location.

![OH Location ID](https://nazkcvruighrhpgcarxg.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/help-documentation-images/dd8adf21-f54b-40a5-9710-71e0e1bd7bc4.png)

### FTP details

Your order artwork is delivered to a Pixfizz FTP server, and OHD downloads it from there. Raise a support ticket in **myPixfizz** to get your **Host**, **Username** and **Password**.

---

## Step 3: Connection tab

In OHD, go to **Settings** → **Connection**.

### OrderHub API

1. Paste your **API Key**, **Organization ID** and **Location ID** into the boxes.
2. Click **Test Connection**.
   * If it works, you'll see **Connected to** followed by your organisation and location names. Check it's the right shop.
   * If it fails, the message tells you why, for example "Location ID not found for this organisation." Check you copied the whole ID.

### FTP Server

1. Enter the **Host**, **Username** and **Password** from Pixfizz support.
2. Leave **Port** as **21**. Set **Remote Path** to the folder Pixfizz support gave you, or leave it as **/** if they didn't give one.
3. Click **Test Connection** in this section. You should see **Connection successful!**
4. **Keep files on the server after downloading**: leave this **off** if you have one location. Turn it **on** if you run OHD at more than one location, otherwise the first location to download an order takes the files and the others can't get them.
   * Note: if you turn this on, ask Pixfizz support whether you also need **Delete old files from the server (retention sweep)**. It needs a specific **Remote Path** and should only be switched on at one location.

The **S3 Storage** section is only needed for Film Scans and File Uploads. You can leave it for now.

![FTP Server Details](https://nazkcvruighrhpgcarxg.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/help-documentation-images/5e5fa006-dfb2-4838-8eb3-c982ca988b6f.png)

---

## Step 4: Downloads tab

Go to **Settings** → **Downloads**.

1. Under **Download Directory**, click **Browse...** and choose the folder on this PC where orders should be saved.
   * Note: pick a folder with plenty of space. Every order's artwork is saved here.
2. Under **Order Artwork Downloads (Mode 1)**, tick **Download new orders automatically**.
   * Note: this is the main on/off switch. It turns on both checking OrderHub for new jobs and downloading their artwork. With it off, OHD won't download anything.
3. Optional: once you've saved your settings (Step 7), click **Scan & Download** under **FTP Scan & Download** to run a one-off download and check everything works.

You don't need **FTP Sources** or **AI Quality Gate** to get started.

![OHD Download Tab](https://nazkcvruighrhpgcarxg.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/help-documentation-images/db09c66e-a482-47bc-8cfc-099ff02d8c99.png)

---

## Step 5: General tab

Go to **Settings** → **General**.

1. **Polling Interval (seconds)**: how often OHD checks for new jobs. Leave it at **60**.
   * Note: OrderHub can set this for you, in which case OHD uses OrderHub's value instead.
2. Tick **Launch on Windows startup**, so OHD starts by itself whenever the PC is switched on.

![OHD Polling Settings](https://nazkcvruighrhpgcarxg.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/help-documentation-images/02857235-db88-443f-a0cf-7614f8a11029.png)

---

## Step 6: Backup tab

Backups save your OHD setup (printers, routing, Prepress templates and settings) so a replacement PC can be up and running quickly.

Go to **Settings** → **Backup**.

1. Tick **Enable automatic daily backups**.
2. **Backup folder**: click **Browse...** and choose a folder on another machine, ideally a network share such as `\\NAS\OHD-Backups\`.
3. Click **Backup Now** and check **Last backup** updates.

For what's included, how to restore after a PC fails, and moving to a new PC, see **Backing Up and Restoring OrderHub Desktop**.

![OHD Backup Tab](https://nazkcvruighrhpgcarxg.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/help-documentation-images/91477edd-2c32-4ecc-9c6c-94c35bd2e5b7.png)

---

## Step 7: Save

Click **Save Settings** at the bottom right of the Settings page. It saves every tab at once, and you'll see **Settings saved successfully!**

If something required is missing, OHD tells you in red under the button and doesn't save. For example:

* "Please fill in the Location ID (required for polling)"
* "Please fill in FTP server settings (required for polling)"
* "Please select a download directory (required for polling)"

Fill in the missing item and click **Save Settings** again. OHD starts checking for jobs straight away.

---

## Good to know

* **Test Connection checks what's on screen**, so you can test before saving.
* **One Location ID per PC.** Each shop's OHD uses its own location.
* **After restoring a backup**, always re-enter the API key and FTP password. They're never backed up. See **Backing Up and Restoring OrderHub Desktop**.
* **Hide art-less jobs from OrderHub Desktop** (OrderHub → **Settings** → **Info**): when this is on, OHD only receives jobs that come from Pixfizz or already have artwork uploaded. Turn it on once your staff upload artwork for POS and API orders.
* Once connected, see **Orders routing to OrderHub Downloader** for making sure products reach the right printer.
